Monitor Amazon inventory automatically: an email alert before stock runs low

The problem

We have been selling our own brand on Amazon since 2021. For a long time we had no systematic view of our inventory: checking simply got lost in day-to-day business, and we often only noticed a product was running low when it was almost sold out.

On Amazon that hurts twice: an empty warehouse not only costs sales, it can also weaken the product's ranking. And restocking takes time.

The solution

The stock levels live in a Google spreadsheet. A Make scenario reads them at fixed intervals and compares each item with a minimum quantity we set per product.

If an item falls below it, an email with the product and current stock is sent automatically. If everything is fine, nothing happens – so there are no unnecessary messages.

The result

  • No more manual checking – monitoring runs on its own
  • Low-stock items are spotted early, with time to reorder
  • Less stress: we no longer have to keep it in mind
